integrityNotes: Projection contains official 1 September Melbourne Cup nominees only.
Highwayman and Amelia Earhart were promoted after the 12 September St Leger; Small Fry entered the 24 after verified two-mile form was added.
Christmas Day was downgraded after finishing ninth in the St Leger but remains in the 24 due to Derby-class ability and the special Northern Hemisphere three-year-old weight context.
Constitution Hill is excluded from projection consideration after failing the first ballot clause in the September Stakes.
Non-nominated Golden Ticket winners remain visible in qualification tracking but are not inserted unless a valid late nomination is confirmed.
